name: Sindhi Fried Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat enough oil in a pot for deep frying.
Add the potatoes and deep fry until golden brown.
Remove potatoes from the oil, and place on paper towels to drain.
Transfer potatoes to a serving plate. Sprinkle with salt, chili powder, coriander, and pepper.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
